ns2:course.label: Curriculum Development in Art
ns2:course.description: Analysis of curriculum organization in the visual arts; particular emphasis given to a range of curriculum positions in education and general research related to curriculum design. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
